docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
 * Summary:  
 * Allocates and initializes a set of pixel channel arrays for multithreaded image processing.  
 *  
 * Parameters:  
 * images (const Image *): Pointer to the image structure containing image data.  
 *  
 * Returns:  
 * PixelChannels **: Pointer to an array of pixel channel arrays, or NULL on failure.  
 *  
 * Logic:  
 * The function first retrieves the maximum number of threads allowed and allocates memory for an array of pixel channel pointers.  
 * It then determines the maximum number of columns across all images.  
 * For each thread, it allocates memory for the pixel channels and initializes them to zero.  
 * If any allocation fails, it cleans up previously allocated memory and returns NULL.  
 ******************************************************************************/
guard_description: Checking and using the maximum number of columns across all images to ensure sufficient memory allocation.
rationale: Implementation B includes a loop to find the maximum number of columns across all images, ensuring that the allocated memory is sufficient for the largest image. Implementation A, on the other hand, uses only the columns from a single image, which may be insufficient if other images have more columns. This makes B safer by ensuring all allocations are based on the maximum needed size.
